title: Tight conversion management can turn **1,000** leads into **12,000 acres** of signed demand across the booking funnel
subtitle: How disciplined qualification, quoting, and booking translate outreach into contracted acreage.

chart.annotation: The pipeline narrows from 1,000 leads to 80 bookings and ends at 12,000 acres of signed demand.

insights.text: **1,000** leads narrow to **400** qualified farmers, concentrating effort on serviceable demand.
The middle funnel converts **220** field surveys into **160** quotes, keeping pre-sales activity tied to real booking intent.
**80** bookings produce **12,000 acres** of signed demand, making booked acreage the output that matters.
